name: Write detailed fanfiction and crossover stories
description: Users asked the AI to write various forms of fanfiction, with a predominant focus on extensive multi-franchise crossover narratives that blend characters and settings from anime, manga, video games, and literature. These requests often included detailed specifications for plot points, character interactions, dialogue, and world-building elements, such as alternate histories, harem scenarios, or sequential story parts.
